## Current scenario audit: core

Current library base: `a33c10e9abfecbe681ff1cd63e600fd8cfcb0de3`; integrated test-port head: `cad3940341320e9054e97603a973eacf789dbc3a`. Source remains Foundation `e4a48e3bdfd8a7cf58a83fd4d5c760e01b93baad`, the 242-method pinned audit. This is semantic assertion accounting, not proof of current Foundation adoption, persistence, bookmarks, transport or scheduling.

Full reconciliation: **197 ported, 23 covered on main, 19 host/adapter-only, 3 intentionally changed = 242 source methods**. Theory-expanded test counts are a separate measure. No blocked/pending-PR source rows remain. Prior audit comments/checkpoints stay historical.

`ported_passed` means the identified neutral assertions pass on the integrated tree; `covered_on_main` points to landed current evidence; `host_adapter_only` stays with the host; `intentionally_changed` names a differing accepted profile. Unless a row says otherwise, its rationale records the gap at original library baseline3287fe1. Refusal metadata placement finding #92 remains a separately queued follow-up and is not hidden in this test-only port.
